{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{3: 'Soft white light seeps through the closed eyelids. The faint clinking of metal instruments reaches your ears first, followed by the sterile scent of disinfectant.'}
{3: 'Consciousness stirs at the call of reality. You wake from the long dream to find familiar faces gathered around you, their expressions etched with worry.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest03.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lucia', 3: "Commandant, you're awake!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Liv', 3: 'Th-Thank goodness... Your brain wave readings showed that everything was normal, but we were still so worried...', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: 'Hold on. The doctor needs to examine the commandant first.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Lee steps in at just the right moment, intercepting Lucia and Liv, who were practically about to jump onto the bed. He then moves aside, making room for the doctor in a white coat to work.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Hippocrates', 3: 'Heart rate normal. Mind Beacon synchronization rate is stable and within safe parameters.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Hippocrates', 3: 'EEG shows alpha and beta wave rhythms have returned to dominance. Abnormal REM sleep readings have disappeared.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Hippocrates', 3: "Alright, 【kuroname】. I'm officially declaring your pseudo-dormancy crisis resolved.", 4: '1'}
{2: '...Pseudo-dormancy?', 3: '26'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Let me explain.', 4: '1'}
{3: "A calm voice cuts through the medical bay as a familiar figure steps inside—tall, lean, and dependable. It's the Science Council's Chief Technology Officer."}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "Several days ago, we detected anomalous readings erupting from the Earth's surface, spreading continuously toward Babylonia. The frequency closely resembles a medium-scale Punishing Virus outbreak.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Just as this disturbance was about to reach our hull, Command Center received a warning. The origin was unknown, but the message was clear:', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'This incoming information contamination is called a Spacequake. It has already affected the alternate world where the sender resides, dragging vast numbers of humans there into the "Dream City."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "And now, this disturbance will interfere with our world as well. There's no way to prevent this disaster from occurring, but we can minimize its effects.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "The anonymous sender will intercept and absorb the main impact of the Spacequake for us. However, residual effects beyond their control will still inevitably spread across the Earth's surface and throughout our hull...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Therefore, she requested that we select someone with strong willpower, capable of withstanding multiple trials, to assist her in handling this situation.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Which is why I ended up entering the Dream Realm with her...', 3: '40'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lucia', 3: 'That was actually an accident.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'Initially, we thought it was just information interference similar to a large-scale Punishing Virus outbreak, so we responded with standard physical countermeasures.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'That was until we detected a signal from the surface called the Dream Machine and discovered that this old model, which should have been decommissioned long ago, could forcibly induce a state of pseudo-dormancy in humans.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'Your memories surrounding the Spacequake appear to have been erased as a result of this as well, Commandant.', 4: '1'}
{3: "She clenches her fists, fingertips digging into her palm without her noticing. It's as if she's reliving the shock and regret of that moment."}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: "We failed to protect you, Commandant. We let you fall into danger... I'm sorry.", 4: '1'}
{2: "It's not your fault, Lucia.", 3: '53', 4: "You've already done great.", 5: '53'}
{2: 'So that Dream Machine was actually The Oneiros, the one we just fought.', 3: '54', 4: "So that's why so many humans ended up in the Dream Realm.", 5: '54'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: 'Let me elaborate.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He swipes open the terminal in his hand, projecting a clear holographic chart to the group.'}

{2: 'Lee', 3: '"The Dream Machine" is just a nickname for the device. Its true identity, as The Oneiros told herself, is nothing more than an entertainment system back in the Golden Age. It projects the users\' inner fantasies through a mental connection.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Lee', 3: 'Many were already concerned that excessive immersion in virtual worlds would trigger all sorts of social issues, so this model faced heavy restrictions and constant controversy from the start.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'As a result, it was produced in extremely limited quantities and quickly discontinued after the Punishing outbreak.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Lee', 3: 'Regardless, it should only be able to establish a mental connection with individuals inside the pod. The fact that The Oneiros managed to "link together" such a massive, collective dream is most likely due to the effects of the Spacequake.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'So basically, she exploited the abnormal data disruption, which is how we got caught and dragged into the Dream Realm.', 3: '66'}
{2: 'That means the people caught up in the disturbance...', 3: '67'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Liv', 3: "There's no need to be concerned. Shortly after we escaped the Dream Realm, we received reports from the surface. Everyone who fell into that pseudo-dormancy state has regained consciousness.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Liv', 3: 'When the medical staff asked them about their experiences, many gave responses such as "That was such a nice dream," or "I wish it could have lasted longer..."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Liv', 3: "From a mental health standpoint, they don't appear to have suffered any serious psychological trauma.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'As she says this, her expression shifts into something between relief and exasperation.'}
{2: 'Liv', 3: "That said, we'll probably have to restrict information about the Dream Machine to some degree.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Liv', 3: "Otherwise, there's no telling if someone might venture into the ruins again to look for that machine, whether out of curiosity or for other reasons.", 4: '1'}
{2: "Well, all things considered, I suppose all's well that ends well.", 3: '78', 4: '但总感觉好像遗忘了什么事情……', 5: '78'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Oh, right, that reminds me. I actually came here to report a new anomaly.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'His tone remains as calm as ever, but his words cause the air in the room to grow heavy with tension.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Take a look at this footage.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory714.jpg'}
{1: "Inside the Church of Machina's Sleep Chamber", 2: 'Meanwhile'}
{2: "Meanwhile, Inside the Church of Machina's Sleep Chamber."}
{1: '1', 3: 'A pale-skinned figure slowly sits up from within a pod filled with coolant. She, too, has just emerged from a long slumber, her body and mind weary.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Zero', 3: 'Well, "Moon"? Did you manage to see the dream you wanted?', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Zero', 3: "I warned you, didn't I? Human desire isn't something you can manage so simply. Just when you think you have everything under control, they'll turn around and bite the hand that feeds.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: "I do hope that you've learnt your lesson from this, that weaving dreams is far too soft an approach to ever reach the true nature of humans.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Zero', 3: "That said... since Mother personally permitted your little indulgence, I suppose I could be gracious enough to clean up the mess you've made... as long as you apologize, of course.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'But the woman sitting half-submerged in the liquid remains oblivious to the prattling beside her, and simply stares blankly at the starry expanse above as droplets of water fall from her hair.'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: "Hey! I'm talking to you here. Rude much?", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Finally unable to bear being ignored any longer, the petulant figure strides directly in front of "Moon," protesting.'}
{2: 'The Moon', 3: "...I'm trying to understand what truly separates my dreams from theirs.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The woman, silent until now, finally responds, though her murmured words sound almost like the ramblings of a dreamer.'}
{2: 'The Moon', 3: 'I used to think that if I, someone incapable of dreaming, could receive dreams given to me by others, that would mean I, too, have earned the right to dream.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Moon', 3: "But someone told me that all I'm doing is stealing the dreams of others, that I'm merely imitating Nozomi, and that my actions are an insult to her memory.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Moon', 3: 'Does that mean we can never truly become human, no matter what we do?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: "...What the heck's that even supposed to mean?", 4: '2'}
{3: 'The twin-tailed mechanoid seems to have had enough with her companion\'s cryptic musings. She lets out a heavy sigh and settles down beside the pod next to "Moon."'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: "I don't get why you're so fixated on trying to imitate humans.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Zero', 3: "Sure, I've had my share of grief over being stuck in this mechanoid body, like having that bastard Zavier mess with me however he pleased, secretly installing all sorts of bizarre functions...", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: "But there hasn't been a single day when I didn't love being myself.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'She lifts her head proudly, gazing toward the distant expanse of stars alongside "Moon."'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: "We'll achieve everything humans have, and then some. We'll even surpass them.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: "The stars they've reached, we'll reach. The great feats they've accomplished, we'll accomplish too.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: "And when they finally realize their mistake and come crawling to us for help, that's when they'll understand just how great the Sage truly was.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'She beams, a tireless smile lighting up her face.'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: 'But until that day comes, we have a duty to lead all our kin forward.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'The dreaming woman remains lost in thought, her gaze fixed on the stars far away.'}
{2: 'The Moon', 3: '...Will we really reach that place one day?', 4: '1'}
{3: "Then, she smiles. As for the true meaning behind the expression, that's something only she can fathom."}
{2: 'The Moon', 3: "I see now. If this path won't work, then I'll just have to try something else.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She rises to her feet. Before leaving, she makes a heartfelt promise to her fellow mechanoid.'}
{2: 'The Moon', 3: "Don't worry. I'll find a dream that truly belongs to us. All of us.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Moon', 3: "This time, I'll make this dream a reality, no matter what it takes.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Just as soon as she's done speaking, she's already gone, vanishing through the door in an instant like a silent stroke of light."}
{2: 'Zero', 3: "...Hey, wait, this is getting out of hand! Hold on, when I said that, I didn't mean you should just pick some random poor soul from the Church to experiment on!", 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Zero rushes after "Moon," who\'s already vanished from the other side of the room. Unfortunately, she\'s far too fast. Within mere moments, Zero loses sight of her completely.'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: 'Oh god, can somebody please stop her?!', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: 'Is anyone there? Hello?! Amina, Spooner, Haicma, Veronica?!', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Zero', 3: 'If nothing else—Z-Zavier?', 4: '2'}
{3: "But there's no response. All that's in the empty room is Zero's echoing voice."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory524.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Intensive Care Unit, Star of Life', 2: 'Babylonia'}
{2: 'Intensive Care Unit, Star of Life, Babylonia.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'As Asimov finishes playing the footage, everyone in the ward falls into silence, stunned.'}
{3: 'After a long while, the "patient" lying in bed—the one who\'s most familiar with the girl from the footage—finally speaks up.'}
{2: 'Based on this footage, it seems that the mysterious person who stopped the Spacequake for us is indeed the same person I met in the dream, Kurumi Tokisaki.', 3: '175'}
{2: "But... I couldn't tell you how she's able to appear in three different sectors of Babylonia at the same time either...", 3: '176'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: 'Could it be a camera malfunction?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Lee offers the simplest, yet most plausible explanation.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: 'If even basic equipment like cameras could all fail at once...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He closes the terminal. His tone is calm, his expression grave.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "Then we'd better pray Babylonia's main engine doesn't die on us next.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Otherwise, this ship and everyone on it will end up as space debris.', 4: '1'}
{3: "He's dead serious."}
{1: '1', 3: "The stifling silence hangs in the air. A while passes until someone speaks again. It's the doctor, who seemed the most detached from the situation."}
{2: 'Hippocrates', 3: "We don't know who she is or where she came from, but her warning did help Babylonia avoid most of the damage.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Hippocrates', 3: "And it's also thanks to her help that we were able to wake the patients stuck in pseudo-dormancy.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Hippocrates', 3: "Based on those two points alone, I'd say we can safely consider her an ally for now.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Lucia, who's sitting by the window, nods."}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: "It was brief, but I did fight alongside her in the Dream Realm. I can say she's a reliable and powerful ally.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "And the way she fights... It's quite remarkable.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He crosses his arms, his expression taking on that analytical look he always wears when something piques his interest.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "It's almost like she can...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Liv', 3: 'Travel through time and space, right?', 4: '2'}
{3: "Liv finishes Lee's sentence with a touch of excitement."}
{2: 'Liv', 3: 'It was only for a moment, but I really saw it happen. Kurumi vanished in an instant, and then she appeared behind the Nightmare in the blink of an eye.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "If she's willing to work with Babylonia, she could be a major asset.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Coming from Lee, that's practically glowing praise."}
{2: 'Well, seeing as everyone agrees...', 3: '213'}
{2: "Let's temporarily classify Kurumi Tokisaki as a friendly collaborator and have Command Center keep an eye out for her.", 3: '214'}
{2: 'After all, we still need to thank her in person.', 3: '215'}
{3: 'Everyone on the team smiles, reaching an unspoken agreement.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: 'That settles it, then. Gray Raven will handle the follow-up from here.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "The Science Council still needs to track down that Dream Machine to prevent this from happening again. Now then, I'll take my—", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Hippocrates', 3: 'Hold on, Asimov.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Hippocrates picks up on the deliberate shift in his words.'}
{2: 'Hippocrates', 3: "If I recall correctly, you haven't come to Star of Life for a routine checkup in three months.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: '...Does it have to be today?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Hippocrates', 3: 'A large number of pseudo-dormancy patients happen to be waking up today, so arranging a full checkup for you is quite convenient.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Hippocrates', 3: "Or were you planning to pick a time when I'd be too busy to see you personally?", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest01.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{3: 'While the ward buzzes with chatter and the low hum of medical equipment, you catch a trace of something familiar from outside the window.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1431.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1181.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1030.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1181.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{3: 'School bells ringing, traffic lights counting down, the long cry of a passing train, and that familiar voice laced with laughter—'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1030.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{3: 'You instinctively turn, as if to chase that dim twilight you glimpsed in the dream, and look out the window beside you.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest03.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1616.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{3: "But there's nothing outside. Nothing but that familiar, artificial blue sky."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1616.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lucia', 3: 'Commandant? Is there something else you need to confirm?', 4: '1'}
{3: "Lucia's voice pulls you back to reality, to this bustling hospital ward."}
{2: "It's nothing.", 3: '262', 4: 'Probably just lingering echoes from the dream.', 5: '262'}
{3: 'You offer the black-haired girl beside you a reassuring explanation, and Lucia returns a gentle smile in response.'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: "It's alright. We all still remember Tokisaki's promise.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'We\'ll meet again when the "time" is right.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1574.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Beneath the Artificial Sky', 2: 'Babylonia'}
{2: 'Beneath the Artificial Sky, Babylonia.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'I see. So this is the world you had to return to at any cost... the world you love so dearly.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Beneath the vast azure artificial sky, the girl stands alone atop the city's highest building."}
{3: 'From here, the magnificent city below resembles a meticulously crafted sandbox.'}
{3: 'Yet, she sees everything happening within it clearly.'}
{3: "That's because the human told her in the dream, word by word, how the people living here struggle, how they laugh..."}
{3: 'And how they clumsily, yet stubbornly, work to make every tomorrow just a little better than today.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: '...I see now, 【kuroname】.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Alright then, I shall witness it for myself.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She leaps down, her figure gradually fading as she vanishes into the flowing wind.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Just what is it about this world that makes you love it so dearly?'}
